build_mask_rcnn_fpn_model: build a Mask R-CNN model with FPN backbone using Detectron2 LazyCall configuration
configure_resnet_backbone: configure a ResNet-50 backbone with FrozenBN normalization and default stages for feature extraction
configure_rpn_proposal_generator: configure the RPN proposal generator with multi-scale anchor sizes and NMS thresholds
configure_roi_heads: configure StandardROIHeads with box and mask heads for 80 class detection and segmentation
configure_roi_pooler: configure ROIPooler with ROIAlignV2 for box and mask feature pooling across FPN levels
